modern: But, my good friend, consider whether what is noble and good is not something different from saving and being saved; for as to a man living for this or that length of time, at least one who is really a man, consider whether this is not a thing to be dismissed from the thoughts: and there must be no love of life; but as to these matters a man must entrust them to the Deity and believe what the women say, that no man can escape his destiny, the next question being how he may best live the time that he has to live.
original: But, my good friend, reflect whether that which is noble and good is not something different from saving and being saved; for as to a man living such or such a time, at least one who is really a man, consider if this is not—a thing to be dismissed from the thoughts: and there must be no love of life: but as to these matters a man must intrust them to the Deity and believe what the women say, that no man can escape his destiny, the next inquiry being how he may best live the time that he has to live.
